# Baruch Chapter 3 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Baruch 3 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/BAR_003_page_001.jpg

---

**1** O Lord Almighty, God of Israel, the soul in anguish and the spirit in distress cry out to you.

**2** Hear, O Lord, and have mercy, for you are a God of mercy; and have mercy upon us, for we have sinned before you.

**3** For you are enthroned forever, but we are perishing forever.

**4** O Lord Almighty, God of Israel, hear now the prayer of the dead of Israel, the sons of those who sinned before you, who did not listen to the voice of the Lord their God, so that calamities have clung to us.

**5** Do not call to mind the iniquities of our ancestors, but remember instead your power and your name at this time.

**6** For you are the Lord our God, and you, O Lord, we will praise.

**7** For it is for this reason that you put your fear in our hearts — that we should call upon your name; and we will praise you in our exile, for we have put away from our hearts all the wickedness of our ancestors who sinned against you.

**8** See, we are today in our exile where you have scattered us, to be a reproach and a curse and an object of punishment for all the iniquities of our ancestors who forsook the Lord our God.

**9** Hear, O Israel, the commandments of life; give ear, so that you may learn wisdom.

**10** How is it, O Israel? Why are you in the land of your enemies? You have grown old in a foreign land;

**11** you are defiled along with the dead, you are counted among those who go down to Hades.

**12** You have forsaken the fountain of wisdom!

**13** If you had walked in the way of God, you would be dwelling in peace forever.

**14** Learn where there is wisdom, where there is strength, where there is understanding, so that you may also know where there is length of days and life, where there is light for the eyes and peace.

**15** Who has found her dwelling place? And who has entered her treasure houses?

**16** Where are the princes of the nations, and those who lorded it over the beasts of the earth,

**17** those who made sport with the birds of heaven, those who hoarded up silver and gold in which people put their trust, with no end to their acquisitions —

**18** those who worked silver with such care, whose craftsmanship is beyond tracing?

**19** They have vanished and gone down to Hades, and others have taken their place.

**20** Younger generations have seen the light and have lived upon the earth, yet they have not known the way of knowledge;

**21** they have not understood her paths, and their children have not received her; she has been kept far from them.

**22** She has not been heard of in Canaan, nor has she been seen in Teman;

**23** the descendants of Hagar who seek understanding on the earth, the traders of Merran and Teman, the storytellers and the seekers of understanding — none of them has found the way of wisdom, nor have they remembered her paths.

**24** O Israel, how great is the house of God! How vast is his domain!

**25** It is great and has no end; it is high and immeasurable.

**26** There the giants were born, the renowned men of old, great in stature and skilled in war.

**27** God did not choose these men, nor did he give them the way of knowledge;

**28** and so they perished because they lacked wisdom; they were destroyed by their own folly.

**29** Who has ascended into heaven and taken her? Who has brought her down from the clouds?

**30** Who has crossed over the sea and found her, and will buy her for pure gold?

**31** No one knows her way or can think out her path.

**32** But the one who knows all things knows her; he found her by his own understanding. The one who established the earth for all ages has filled it with four-footed creatures.

**33** The one who sends out the light — and it goes; he summons it, and it obeys him with trembling.

**34** The stars shine out at their appointed stations and are glad; he calls them, and they say, "Here we are!" They shine with joy for the one who made them.

**35** This is our God; no other can be compared to him.

**36** He found out the whole way of knowledge and gave her to his servant Jacob and to Israel, whom he loved.

**37** After this she appeared on the earth and lived among human beings.

**38** She is the book of the commandments of God, and the law that endures forever. All who hold fast to her will live, and those who forsake her will die.

---
*LOGOS notes: v.37 — "she appeared on the earth and lived among human beings" renders Greek ōphthē en tē gē kai en tois anthrōpois synanestraphē. The verb synanestraphē (aorist passive of synastrephō) means "was conversed with / mixed among / dwelt with." The author's intended referent is Wisdom-as-Torah (see v.38), but the formulation is strikingly incarnational and has been widely cited in christological discussions (Justin Martyr, Clement of Alexandria, Origen). LOGOS renders straightforwardly without prejudicing interpretation.*
